SMTO-MEM-0025 — The embeddings model sent back data SMTO can't use

GUID: 9eec1671-a025-5f7b-9df3-d4709589edfc
Slug: knowledge-invalid-embedding-vectors
Domain: MEM · Subsystem: knowledge

What happened

  • Knowledge asked the embeddings model to turn text into search data, but the reply didn't have the expected size or shape. So this document or search couldn't be processed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Knowledge › Document settings and check that Embedding dimensions matches the size the embeddings model produces, as listed in that model's documentation. SMTO rejects every reply whose size differs from this setting.
  2. Check that Text embedding model names the model the service actually runs. A different model returns data of a different size.
  3. If you use Settings › Setup › Model routing › Embeddings, assign the instance there, then select Apply Embeddings and rebuild if needed in Knowledge › Document settings. Applying copies the assigned model's real settings into Knowledge and rebuilds search data to match.
  4. Select Retry failed jobs in Knowledge, or Manage › Reindex on the affected document. Once the settings match, indexing can run again safely.

What success looks like

  • Documents show Ready to search, and Test retrieval returns passages.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with the name of the embeddings model, to the person who manages SMTO. Don't delete documents or memories; their search data is rebuilt once the settings match.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The bundled or managed embedding encoder returned vectors that failed validation (wrong number of vectors for the inputs, a dimension different from the profile's dimensions, or non-numeric values), so encode raised invalid_embedding_vectors; the same mismatch from a remote http endpoint is reported as embedding_provider_unavailable.

What this means

  • The embedding service returned data that does not match the search configuration. The original operation and completed work retain their own recorded outcomes; this diagnostic does not replay them.

Why this can happen

  • The component reported invalid_embedding_vectors. This does not establish the outcome of unrelated operations.

How to diagnose it

  • The provider returns vectors with the configured dimensions.
  • Inspect the error reference and the affected component’s current observation before selecting a recovery action.

How to fix it

  • Compare the provider's actual output dimension and model with the profile's text_model and dimensions (Knowledge settings or the applied Embeddings assignment). Correct the profile, or reassign and apply Embeddings so indexes rebuild, then retry failed jobs.
  • Ask an administrator to check that the selected embedding model and dimensions match the configured encoder. Run its connection test before rebuilding indexes.

Retry and execution caution

  • The provider returns vectors with the configured dimensions.

How to verify the fix

  • The provider returns vectors with the configured dimensions.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained task data or repeat an operation with an unknown outcome.

Technical notes

  • Status checks do not replay tasks or modify source documents.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
